assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a NEW state illustration of THE LISTENER for CosyWorld. Image 1 is the exact character identity and antique-engraving style reference; preserve the same upright wooden confessional box, weathered black paint worn to grey wood, ogee arched brass lattice grille, brass letter-slot plate, mossy shingle roof, four iron-rimmed spoked cart wheels, fine dark cross-hatched ink linework and muted hand-coloured watercolour palette of dull brass, grey-black wood, moss green and iron. Same three-quarter view, grille side toward the viewer, facing RIGHT. No face, eyes or creature may ever be visible behind the grille. Render a complete 1024 x 1536 portrait PNG with genuine transparent background and clean alpha through wheel spokes and under the box. Keep all roof corners and wheels inside generous empty margins, around 60 pixels all sides. No scenery, floor, cast ground shadow, text, border or watermark. HAPPY STATE: a faint restrained amber warmth glows deep behind the grille while the interior stays dark and featureless; no bright yellow lamp, no silhouette, no glowing eyes. A single anatomically clear BLACK-GLOVED hand rests palm-up on the brass slot sill in a small welcoming gesture. Four distinct relaxed fingers curl together over the sill; the thumb is naturally alongside the palm, short and unobtrusive. This is an open inviting hand, not a single long protruding finger. No card or object is held. Convey warmth only through this glove and subtle glow. The rest of the box, roof, grille, paint and wheels remains the same.
